h1.en: Which Power Cell HBT80-16 Concrete Pump Prints
h1.zh: HBT80-16混凝土泵的动力格子印了什么

directAnswer.en: Hebei Pinjin Machinery prints the HBT80-16 Concrete Pump power text in Xingtai as: Motor Power is 110 kW. An electric motor cell is kilowatts on a motor. A diesel cell names the engine line that is actually printed. The frame “Relief valve” shows Pressure relief valve DN25 on cooling water. It does not change this power cell, and a diesel code is not copied onto an electric row.
directAnswer.zh: 河北品锦机械在邢台把HBT80-16混凝土泵的动力文字印成：电机功率是110 kW。电机格是电机上的千瓦。柴油格只写这一页真正印出的发动机行。画面「Relief valve」的主体是压力 溢流阀 DN25 on cooling water。它不改这一格动力，也不会把柴油机代号抄到电动行上。

heading.en: Read the power label that is present
heading.zh: 只读已经印出的动力标题

body.en: Motor Power is 110 kW. Electric drive and diesel drive are different supplies. Use the label on this sheet, not the neighbouring model's label. Theoretical Output remains 50 m³/h. Pumping Pressure remains 40 MPa.
body.zh: 电机功率是110 kW。电动和柴油是两种供电。用这一页的标题，不用旁边那个型号的标题。理论输送量仍是50 m³/h。泵送压力仍是40 MPa。

heading.en: A power-unit frame is not a nameplate
heading.zh: 动力装置画面不是铭牌

body.en: The frame is from en.wikipedia.org, “Relief valve”, and its subject is Pressure relief valve DN25 on cooling water. Hebei Pinjin Machinery does not lift kilowatts or an engine code out of that frame. If this row has no voltage cell, none is invented.
body.zh: 这一帧来自 en.wikipedia.org 的「Relief valve」，主体是压力 溢流阀 DN25 on cooling water。河北品锦机械不从这一帧里提取千瓦或发动机代号。这一行如果没有电压格，就不编一个电压。

heading.en: Power does not set the pipe size

body.en: Max. Aggregate Size 4 cm and below. Delivery Pipe Diameter 100 / 125 mm. Total Weight 6500 kg. Those cells, when printed, stay in their own columns. A larger motor cell is not a longer pipeline.
body.zh: 最大骨料粒径 4 cm and below。输送管内径 100 / 125 mm。整机重量 6500 kg。这些格子如果印了，就留在各自的列里。电机千瓦更大，并不等于管路更长。

question.en: What power text does HBT80-16 Concrete Pump print?
question.zh: HBT80-16混凝土泵的动力文字是什么？

question.en: Can a diesel code be moved onto this row?
question.zh: 可以把柴油机代号挪到这一行吗？

answer.en: Only if this row already prints it. Otherwise the cell stays as written.
answer.zh: 只有这一行已经印了才能算。否则格子保持原样。

question.en: Does the frame show the Xingtai kilowatts?
question.zh: 这一帧显示了邢台的千瓦吗？

answer.en: No. Kilowatts are taken from the catalogue cell, not from the frame.
answer.zh: 没有。千瓦取自目录格，不取自这一帧。

question.en: What are output and pressure on this sheet?
question.zh: 这一页的输送量和压力是多少？

answer.en: Theoretical Output is 50 m³/h. Pumping Pressure is 40 MPa.
answer.zh: 理论输送量是50 m³/h。泵送压力是40 MPa。
